about.heading: Hello, awesome people.
about.text: I'm Al Mamun — a passionate and energetic logo & branding expert from Bangladesh, specialised in logo and brand identity design. My designs are always bold, fresh and distinctive. I'm a problem solver and I love working on challenging projects with brands that look to make an impact. I believe a logo is the foundation of a brand's visual identity — a well-crafted logo conveys meaning in an instant and acts as a powerful shorthand for the brand it represents. The best logos have one thing in common: they are simple and versatile.
